text:
incident-bot: PAGER — Sev2: Elevated KV cache miss rate and spikes in hosted-api tail latency (<https://dash.redwood/internal/alerts/1719350400|details>)
laura: I'm on the page. seeing 5xxs up ~2.3% and P99 latency up ~800ms for text-generation endpoints.
mike: paging me — oncall. can you dump a quick top-prefix miss list?
sasha: got it, pulling from cache telemetry now.
ops-bot: cache-metrics-export: top_miss_prefixes: ["kv:prompts_v3", "kv:session_kv", "kv:embeds:recent"] — miss rate for kv:prompts_v3 = 62% over 10m.
laura: looks like a rollout earlier this morning changed prefix keys (hashing tweak). lots of keys not found -> backend rehydration -> backend throttles -> queuing -> latency.
ben: any customer-facing errors? which customers hit 5xxs?
sasha: filtering request logs: 8 customers with >1% error rate, two customers (acme-inc, playbook-ai) have spikes after 08:10 UTC.
response-lead: creating incident ticket INC-2024-512 and posting to status page. i'll add customer list to the ticket.
laura: mitigation options: 1) revert hashing tweak (risky, needs deploy), 2) enable cache-bypass for correctness for affected model (force origin reads), 3) temporarily increase prefix cache capacity / TTL for affected prefixes, 4) rate limit problematic tenants to protect the cache and backend.
mike: since revert is heavy, prefer live patching: (a) pin top prefixes into KV cache (fast), (b) turn on per-request cache-bypass for models where correctness matters to avoid silent incorrect answers, (c) apply soft rate-shaping on heavy tenants to reduce rehydration storm.
sasha: commands to pin prefixes (runbook):
```
redwood cache pin \--prefix "kv:prompts_v3" \--count 2000 --ttl 1h
redwood cache pin \--prefix "kv:session_kv" \--count 1000 --ttl 30m
```
laura: and to toggle bypass for model redwood/gptx-3b:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/debug/toggle_cache_bypass" -d '{"model":"redwood/gptx-3b","bypass":true,"duration":600}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN"
```
ben: I'll run the pins now and then enable bypass for gptx-3b for 10 minutes while we monitor.
ops-bot: action queued: cache pin for kv:prompts_v3 (2000) by ben at 1719350565
ben: pinned kv:prompts_v3 and kv:session_kv.
laura: enabling bypass for gptx-3b (10m). note: this will increase origin load but guarantees correctness for customers using streaming.
sasha: applying soft tenant shaping: reduce burst tokens for free-tier from 6000/min -> 2000/min for next 15m. command:
```
redwood quota update --tier free --burst 2000 --duration 900
```
mike: shaping applied. also temporarily disabled large-chunk streaming for affected endpoints (will fall back to chunked 256 token streams).
ops-bot: quota-change event recorded by policy-engine at 1719350640
laura: monitoring dashboards... P99 latency dropping from +800ms -> +180ms after pins and shaping. error rate falling: 5xxs down to 0.6%.
response-lead: notified acme-inc and playbook-ai with ETA 20m for stabilization.
ben: bypass window expires in ~4m. we should decide whether to extend or schedule a quick rollback of the hashing tweak.
mike: let's not extend yet; continue monitoring for 10m after bypass ends. if tails regress, plan: schedule a controlled small rollback for hashing tweak with canary.
sasha: adding a canary config to re-hash 2% of traffic back to old mapping for verification. command:
```
redwood rollout canary --service cache-key-hash --percent 2 --duration 30m
```
laura: good. also adding a short-term runbook step: when KV miss spike >50% for top prefix, first action pin top N keys, then shape traffic if origin errors >5/s.
response-lead: logging the mitigation steps into INC-2024-512. will assign postmortem to eng-runtime.
ben: after bypass expired: latency stayed low, 5xx stable ~0.4%. looks green.
mike: thumbs. please capture exact commands and timestamps for postmortem.
laura: noted. action items: 1) eng-runtime to add migration test for key hashing changes 2) update runbook with pin/shape/bypass sequence 3) schedule rollback/canary plan review with product 4) customer follow-ups.
response-lead: handing off to night oncall (ben) at 1719351000 — ben will monitor dashboards for next 2 hours.
ben: taking over. if anything spikes I'll page SRE immediately. :thumbsup: 
laura: thanks team. nice coordinated mitigation. :heart:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (conditional) — monitors will run for 3h.
